findings.claim: The `case <= byte.MaxValue` (Str8) branch was removed from the string-header writer. Every string whose UTF-8 length is 32..255 bytes now gets a 3-byte Str16 header (0xDA) instead of a 2-byte Str8 header (0xD9). This changes the wire format of very common payloads: each such string grows by one byte and is no longer the minimal encoding the MessagePack spec asks for. Any byte-exact consumer, cache key or hash of serialized data breaks. The serializer-runtime change is unrelated to REQ-2234.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.ReceiptsReq2234LogicTests.StringOf100Bytes_UsesStr8Header and WriteStringHeader100_UsesStr8Header. On head the first byte is 0xDA (length 103) instead of 0xD9 (length 102). Also byte-diff MessagePackSerializer.Serialize(new string('a', 100)) between base-built and head-built code.

findings.claim: No hunk touches the SuppressSourceGeneration handling. The only TypeCollector changes are duplicate-key and mixed-key guards. A [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] type with a public member that lacks [Key] should still get MsgPack004 from the analyzer (acceptance criterion 1), but nothing in the change makes the analyzer visit such types.

receipt_plan.detail: Run Receipts.GeneratedTests.ReceiptsReq2234LogicTests.SuppressSourceGeneration_StillReportsMsgPack004. It runs every DiagnosticAnalyzer from the generator assembly over a SuppressSourceGeneration=true type whose public member has no [Key], and asserts that MsgPack004 is reported.

findings.claim: Two members with the same [Key(n)] or the same string key used to throw from Dictionary.Add. They are now silently de-duplicated with `if (!ContainsKey) Add`. The second member is dropped from the collected members, and no diagnostic is reported at that point. The generated formatter therefore silently omits that member, losing its data on round-trip, where previously the generator failed loudly.

receipt_plan.detail: The ContainsKey guards at TypeCollector.cs:1023-1026, 1039-1042, 1163-1166 and 1179-1182 skip the colliding member and invoke no reportDiagnostic. To confirm, run the generator on `[MessagePackObject] public class C { [Key(0)] public int A {get;set;} [Key(0)] public int B {get;set;} }` and check whether any diagnostic is emitted and whether B appears in the generated formatter.
